# PM009: ready-unsized

A ready ticket (`todo`, not an epic) has no story points.

## Remedy

Size the ticket (`frob ticket edit --points N`) or move it out of the ready queue.

## Examples

### PM009 unsized ticket in ready / A ready ticket without points fires #1 (line 8) (fire)

```text
task a
```

### PM009 unsized ticket in ready / A sized ready ticket is silent #2 (line 14) (clean)

```text

```

